name: motif_author_exception_feature
description:
Add an exception feature. Research first: motif_guide topic suffix-prefix-slots; check best practice. Use only if an affix, rule or compound must be limited to an arbitrary set of stems; otherwise use an inflection class for a declension or conjugation, or a category. A feature for one stem is a stem list (guide suffix-prefix-slots). Stages a new exception feature in the project's Exception Features list, the tag that stems carry and affixes or rules can require. It refuses a name the list already has. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-author-exception-feature. Agent class: Draft.

name.description: Name of the feature, such as the class of stems it marks.

ws.description: Writing system tag of the name and abbreviation.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.
